name: Changelog Preview
description: Renders one or more admin-configured Markdown CHANGELOG files as HTML pages inside a Drupal site.
project_description: Changelog Preview displays one or more Markdown changelog files as HTML pages inside a Drupal site. An administrator configures, at /admin/changelog_manage, a repeatable list of changelog items; each item pairs a server-relative file path with a display name and a browser path (URL). The module registers a dynamic route for each configured item, reads the file from disk on request, converts it from Markdown to HTML with the michelf/php-markdown library, and renders it. A toolbar tab and dynamic local tasks link to the configured changelogs, and an index page at /changelog/base lists them. Pages are gated by a single 'view changelog' permission that the maintainer suggests can be granted to any role, including anonymous. The module ships a small CSS library to style code blocks. It is authored and supported by Landwirtschaftsverlag GmbH.
